subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding prefixes, suffixes or both with the root words given in the parenthesis:
stimulus: 0.5 x 10=5 Life without leisure and (a) ____ (relax) is dull. Nobody can work without rest. Life becomes (b) ____(charm) if man does not have any time to enjoy (c) ____(beauty) objects of nature. (d) (Monotony) work hinders the (e) ____ (smooth) of work. Leisure (f) ____ (new) our spirit of work. Everybody knows that (g) ____ (work) is (h) ____(harm). Leisure does not mean (i) ____ (idle). It gives (j) ____(fresh) to our mind.
guide_solution: (a) relaxation (b) charmless (c) beautiful (d) monotonous (e) smoothness (f) renews (g) overwork (h) harmful (i) idleness (j) refreshment
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Chattogram Board-2022 (Board Question With Solution)
